item.title: Anthropic 提交 IPO 申请，拟以「ANT」登陆纳斯达克
item.guid: Anthropic-提交-IPO-申请，拟以「ANT」登陆纳斯达克
item.description:
Anthropic 10 月 26 日向美国证监会公开提交 S-1 注册文件，计划在纳斯达克以「ANT」为代码上市。公司称，拟发行股数和价格区间尚未确定，注册文件也尚未生效。

招股书披露，今年上半年营收为 162.86 亿美元，去年同期为 11.63 亿美元；GAAP 净亏损为 807.48 亿美元。其中，可转债、衍生负债及未来股权简单协议的公允价值变动造成 723.88 亿美元损失，主要与公司估值上升有关，不能等同于同期现金消耗。

经营层面的亏损为 6.93 亿美元。剔除股权激励、非现金慈善捐赠等项目后，经调整经营利润为 16.18 亿美元，属于非 GAAP 口径。

文件同时提示，未来收入增长可能放缓，算力和基础设施扩张会继续带来成本压力；高度自主的 AI 系统若被滥用或缺少适当防护，也可能造成灾难性风险。公司创始人实体持有的特殊 F 类股份，将拥有一般股东表决事项 50.1% 的投票权。

🔗 相关阅读： 突发！Anthropic 公开上市申请，史上最大 IPO 要来了

item.title: 5499 元起，iPad mini 8 发布，仍无高刷
item.guid: 5499-元起，iPad-mini-8-发布，仍无高刷
item.description:
昨晚，苹果在官网低调上线新款 iPad mini，换用 8.5 英寸 OLED 超视网膜 XDR 显示屏与 A20 Pro 芯片，机身薄至 5.4 毫米，无线局域网版重 255 克。 屏幕升级后仍不支持 120Hz ProMotion 高刷新率。

新机的主要变化包括：

  • 显示屏边框收窄 24%，HDR 峰值亮度最高 1200 尼特，最低亮度 1 尼特；256GB 和 512GB 机型可选纳米纹理玻璃。
  • A20 Pro 采用 2 纳米工艺，均配 7 核 GPU；128GB、256GB 版为 5 核 CPU 与单 16 核神经网络引擎，512GB 版升级为 6 核 CPU 和双 16 核神经网络引擎。
  • 新增 Acoustic Display 音频系统，并支持 IP67 级抗水防尘；前置 1200 万像素 Center Stage 摄像头移到长边。N1 芯片支持 Wi-Fi 7、蓝牙 6 和 Thread，蜂窝版搭载 C2 基带。

    Supports fast charging, and can be charged up to 50% in about 30 minutes with a separately sold 35W or higher compatible adapter.

The new model is available in Midnight and Starlight colors, starting at 5499 yuan for the 128GB Wi-Fi version and 6799 yuan for the cellular version. Pre-orders begin on October 28, with sales starting on November 6. The concurrently launched Smart Folio made of tech fabric is priced at 599 yuan, supporting Apple Pencil Pro and Apple Pencil (USB-C). 新款提供午夜色与星光色，128GB 无线局域网版 5499 元起，蜂窝版 6799 元起，10 月 28 日接受订购，11 月 6 日发售。同步推出的科技织物智能双面夹售价 599 元，支持 Apple Pencil Pro 与 USB-C 版 Apple Pencil。

🔗 Related Reading: New iPad mini Released: Starting from 5499 Yuan! Has Everything Except High Refresh Rate 🔗 相关阅读： 新 iPad mini 发布：5499 元起！应有尽有，除了高刷

item.title: 苹果回应 iPhone Duo 内屏开裂：少量设备受影响，可联系 AppleCare 换机
item.guid: 苹果回应-iPhone-Duo-内屏开裂：少量设备受影响，可联系-AppleCare-换机
item.description:
Apple has responded for the first time to complaints about iPhone Duo inner screen cracking. In a statement sent to the media, Apple stated that it has noticed issues with a small number of iPhone Duo inner screens, and users experiencing display anomalies should contact AppleCare for device replacement. 苹果首次回应 iPhone Duo 内屏开裂投诉。在发给媒体的声明中，苹果表示已注意到少量 iPhone Duo 的内屏存在问题，遇到显示异常的用户应联系 AppleCare 更换设备。

We have learned that there are issues with the inner screens of a small number of iPhone Duo devices. If a user's iPhone Duo display has problems, they should contact AppleCare for device replacement.

Apple also stated that the vast majority of devices are unaffected, and problematic models typically show faults early in their use. 苹果还表示，绝大多数设备不受影响，问题机型通常在使用初期就会显现故障。

According to Apple employees, the company has not yet issued formal guidelines to retail stores and customer service staff, but teams have already launched investigations, and some engineers are trying to recover affected devices for analysis. 据苹果员工透露，公司尚未向零售门店和客服人员下发正式指引，但已有团队展开调查，部分工程师正设法回收受影响设备进行分析。

Previously, some users uploaded photos of inner screens cracking along the hinge midline on forums like Reddit. iFixit teardowns had suggested that components might be exerting excessive pressure on the screen. 此前，部分用户在 Reddit 等论坛上传了内屏沿铰链中线开裂的照片。iFixit 拆解提出过部件可能向屏幕施加过大压力的推测。

item.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Terra，API 价格减半、电脑操作提速
item.guid: OpenAI-发布-GPT-6.1-Terra，API-价格减半、电脑操作提速
item.description:
OpenAI has released GPT-6.1 Terra, focusing on visual understanding, computer operation, and natural writing. It is now available to Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users of ChatGPT Work and Codex, and developers can access it via API calls. OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Terra，主打视觉理解、电脑操作和自然写作，已向 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 的 Plus、Pro、Enterprise 和 Edu 用户开放，开发者可通过 API 调用。

OpenAI stated that the standard API price for the new model is 50% lower than GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol: $1 per million input tokens, $0.05 for cached input, and $5 for output. OpenAI 表示，新模型标准 API 价格比 GPT-5.6 Terra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 低 50%：每百万输入 Token 为 1 美元、缓存输入为 0.05 美元、输出为 5 美元。

In the "Agents' Last Exam" test, which includes professional tasks like converting architectural drawings to 3D models, Terra scored 15 percentage points higher than the previous generation at medium inference intensity, with results comparable to GPT-6 Astra; officially, it completes computer operation tasks more than 3 times faster than GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol. 在包含建筑图纸转 3D 模型等专业任务的 Agents」 Last Exam 测试中，Terra 在中等推理强度下比上一代高出 15 个百分点，成绩与 GPT-6 Astra 相当；官方称，完成电脑操作任务的速度超过 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 3 倍。

In terms of programming, Terra achieved a 50.3% pass rate on Terminal-Bench 4.0 at maximum inference intensity, compared to the previous generation's public score of 21.5%. OpenAI still lists Sol and Astra as preferred choices for the most complex programming tasks. 编程方面，Terra 在最高推理强度下的 Terminal-Bench 4.0 通过率为 50.3%，上一代公开成绩为 21.5%。OpenAI 仍将 Sol 和 Astra 列为最复杂编程任务的优先选择。

🔗 Related Reading: Just Released: GPT-6.1 Terra at a "Fracture Price," the Agent Era's Workhorse Model is Here 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，GPT-6.1 Terra 骨折价发布，Agent 时代的打工模型来了

item.title: 苹果正式推送 iOS 27.2：Apple Music 迎来黑白新设计、iPhone Duo 支持 Apple Pencil
item.guid: 苹果正式推送-iOS-27.2：Apple-Music-迎来黑白新设计、iPhone-Duo-支持-Apple-Pencil
item.description:
Early this morning, Apple officially pushed out the iOS 27.2 update, which includes design adjustments for multiple native apps and expanded Siri language support. 今天凌晨，苹果正式推送了 iOS 27.2 更新，针对多项原生应用进行设计调整，并扩展了 Siri 的语言支持。

In terms of visual and interface design, the Apple Music icon has been adjusted from traditional red to a black and white design, the accent color for selected tabs has been replaced from red to blue, and a music widget with a black background has also been introduced. 在视觉与界面设计上，Apple Music 图标由传统的红色调整为黑白设计，选中的标签页强调色也由红色替换为蓝色，同时推出了黑色背景的音乐小组件。

This update also adds support for Apple Pencil (USB-C) to iPhone Duo. 本次更新还为 iPhone Duo 增加了对 Apple Pencil（USB-C）的支持。

At the functional level, Siri's AI language capabilities have been further expanded, with new support for 5 languages including French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish. 在功能层面，Siri AI 语言能力得到进一步扩展，新增支持法语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语和西班牙语等 5 种语言。

Other native apps and features have also received corresponding improvements. 其他原生应用与功能也迎来了相应改进。

    The Messages app adds a "Suggested Actions" feature, which automatically provides shortcuts like creating schedules or reminders based on conversation content;

    The Podcasts app now separates "New Episodes" and "Now Playing" on the homepage;

    Apple TV has added support for multi-user profiles;

    Group FaceTime's two-way shooting feature has been extended to group calls, allowing users to share both front and rear camera views simultaneously during a call (not available in mainland China).

In terms of smart home, compatible smart door locks have added "automatic locking after closing" and "door open too long reminder" options, and HomePod also supports "lock control" after the update. 智能家居方面，兼容的智能门锁新增了「关闭后自动上锁」和「开门过久提醒」选项，HomePod 更新后也已支持「锁定控制」。

item.title: 华为畅享系列累计发货突破 1.6 亿台，畅享 100 将于 10 月 28 日发布
item.guid: 华为畅享系列累计发货突破-1.6-亿台，畅享-100-将于-10-月-28-日发布
item.description:
He Gang, Huawei Director and Terminal BG CEO, posted on October 26 that the Huawei Enjoy series has been around for 11 years, with cumulative shipments exceeding 160 million units. He listed durability, reliability, and long battery life as reasons why users choose this series, and thanked users for their long-term support. 华为董事、终端 BG CEO 何刚 10 月 26 日发文表示，华为畅享系列走过 11 年，累计发货量已突破 1.6 亿台。他将耐用可靠和续航持久列为用户选择这一系列的原因，并感谢用户长期使用。

The new generation Enjoy 100 series will be released on October 28 at 14:30. The 160 million units announced this time refer to the cumulative shipments of the entire Enjoy series, covering multiple generations of products, not the order volume or sales of the Enjoy 100. 新一代畅享 100 系列将于 10 月 28 日 14:30 发布。此次公布的 1.6 亿台是畅享整个系列的累计发货口径，覆盖多代产品，不是畅享 100 的订单量或销量。

item.title: 小鹏悠游获批 L4 级示范运营，初期仍凭邀请码体验
item.guid: 小鹏悠游获批-L4-级示范运营，初期仍凭邀请码体验
item.description:
XPENG Robotaxi has obtained the qualification for intelligent connected vehicle application demonstration operation in Guangzhou, allowing it to conduct L4-level demonstration operations across the entire city. Nandu Bay Finance learned from XPENG Group on October 26 that initially, "XPENG YOYO" will still gradually open up experiences through invitation codes and steadily expand its service scope. 小鹏 Robotaxi 取得广州市智能网联汽车应用示范运营资格，可在广州全域开展 L4 级示范运营。南都·湾财社 10 月 26 日从小鹏集团获悉，初期「小鹏悠游」仍将通过邀请码逐步开放体验，并稳步扩大服务范围。

This marks a step forward in gaining access to real-world travel services, following road tests and internal employee testing. In May this year, XPENG's first Robotaxi mass-produced vehicle rolled off the production line; in July, it completed the full chain from online ordering to automatic pickup and delivery; in August, it obtained the qualification for road testing without a safety driver in Guangzhou. In October, the business was named "XPENG YOYO," and its ride-hailing mini-program was launched simultaneously. 这是在道路测试和员工内测之后，面向真实出行服务的一次准入推进。今年 5 月，小鹏首台 Robotaxi 量产车下线；7 月打通线上下单、自动接驾至送达的全链路；8 月取得广州主驾无安全员道路测试资质。10 月，业务定名「小鹏悠游 XPENG YOYO」，打车小程序同步上线。

XPENG YOYO is built on the XPENG GX, equipped with 4 self-developed Turing AI chips and the second-generation VLA large model. He Xiaopeng previously stated that the business positioning is to provide partners with vehicle platforms, autonomous driving software, and AI capabilities, with partners undertaking local fleet operations, and revenue coming from hardware sales, technical services, and commission sharing. 小鹏悠游基于小鹏 GX 打造，搭载 4 颗自研图灵 AI 芯片和第二代 VLA 大模型。何小鹏此前表示，业务定位是向合作伙伴提供整车平台、自动驾驶软件和 AI 能力，由伙伴承担当地车队运营，收入来自硬件销售、技术服务与佣金分成。

item.title: DeepSeek Flash 1017 登顶 OpenRouter 周用量榜，处理 33.6 万亿 Token
item.guid: DeepSeek-Flash-1017-登顶-OpenRouter-周用量榜，处理-33.6-万亿-Token
item.description:
OpenRouter's usage ranking for the most recent week, as of October 25, shows that DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 processed 33.6 trillion Tokens, an 801% increase month-on-month, ranking first. OpenRouter 截至 10 月 25 日的最近一周用量榜显示，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 处理了 33.6 万亿 Token，环比增长 801%，位居第一。

The second to fifth places on the list are DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free Version, GLM 5.3 Flash, and Tencent Hy4 preview, with processing volumes of 18 trillion, 13.7 trillion, 13.2 trillion, and 8.97 trillion Tokens, respectively. 榜单第二至第五名依次为 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、MiniMax M3.1 Flash 免费版、GLM 5.3 Flash 和腾讯 Hy4 preview，处理量分别为 18 万亿、13.7 万亿、13.2 万亿和 8.97 万亿 Token。

This list compiles input and output Tokens processed via the OpenRouter API, excluding requests where users or applications opted for confidentiality. Different variants of the same model are ranked separately. It reflects platform-internal usage and does not cover direct services from global vendors, nor is it a ranking of accuracy or inference capabilities. 这份榜单统计经 OpenRouter API 处理的输入与输出 Token，排除用户或应用选择保密的请求，同一模型的不同变体单独排名。它反映平台内的使用量，不涵盖全球各厂商直连服务，也不是准确率或推理能力榜。

OpenRouter also calculates vendor share by the number of text requests: in the week starting October 19, DeepSeek accounted for 26.5%, also ranking first. The proportion of request counts and total Tokens are two different metrics. OpenRouter 另按文本请求次数统计厂商份额：在 10 月 19 日开始的一周，DeepSeek 占比为 26.5%，同样排名第一。请求次数占比与 Token 总量是两项不同指标。

item.title: SK 海力士回应特别股息传闻：方案未定，拟于 28 日公布股东回报安排
item.guid: SK-海力士回应特别股息传闻：方案未定，拟于-28-日公布股东回报安排
item.description:
According to South Korean media Edaily, SK Hynix responded to rumors of a special dividend on October 26, stating that the company is exploring various shareholder value enhancement schemes, which are currently undecided; new arrangements are expected to be disclosed on October 28 when the third-quarter results are released, following a board resolution. 据韩国 Edaily 报道，SK 海力士 10 月 26 日回应特别股息传闻称，公司正研究多种提升股东价值的回报方案，目前尚未确定；拟在董事会决议后，于 10 月 28 日发布第三季度业绩时披露新增安排。

Previously, Korean media reported that SK Hynix was considering using the proceeds from selling its stake in Japanese memory manufacturer Kioxia to pay out approximately 16 trillion Korean won in special dividends. 此前有韩媒称，SK 海力士考虑利用出售日本存储厂商铠侠股权所得收益，派发约 16 万亿韩元特别股息。

SK Hynix had previously announced a 40 trillion Korean won share repurchase and full cancellation plan. Edaily reported that the repurchase was completed ahead of schedule on October 21, and all purchased shares will be canceled. SK 海力士此前已宣布 40 万亿韩元的股份回购及全额注销计划。Edaily 报道称，回购于 10 月 21 日提前完成，所购股份将全数注销。

item.title: Kimi 为 K3.1 Pro 限流致歉并重置额度
item.guid: Kimi-为-K3.1-Pro-限流致歉并重置额度
item.description:
Kimi publicly apologized yesterday for the rate limiting and unnecessary quota consumption issues in its K3.1 Pro subscription plan, and announced a one-time usage reset for all subscribers. Kimi 昨日就 K3.1 Pro 订阅计划中出现的限流和不必要的额度消耗公开致歉，并宣布对所有套餐的订阅用户做一次性用量重置。

Kimi officially stated on X that these issues "were on us" and should have been fixed earlier. The compensation plan is: each subscriber of all plans will have 25% of their monthly quota restored, equivalent to one week's usage. Kimi 官方在 X 上表示，这些问题「出在我们」，本应更早修复。补偿方案是：所有套餐的每位订阅用户恢复月度额度的 25%，相当于一周用量。

For those whose current usage is below 25%, it will be directly reset to zero. Kimi also stated that it has adjusted package parameters and is reducing unnecessary sub-agent calls and output lengths to allow the same quota to complete more actual tasks. 当前用量低于 25% 的，直接重置为零。Kimi 还称，已调整套餐参数，正在减少不必要的子智能体调用和输出长度，让同样的额度完成更多实际任务。

This incident occurred two days after the release of K3.1 Pro. One of the key upgrade focuses for this model is financial research. Kimi's internal tests show that its financial modeling score increased from 50.4 for K3 to 57.6, and its financial research score increased from 58.8 to 70.4. 此次事件发生在 K3.1 Pro 发布两天后。该模型的升级重点之一是金融研究，Kimi 内部测试显示，其金融建模得分由 K3 的 50.4 升至 57.6，金融研究得分由 58.8 升至 70.4。

item.title: 奥迪中国明确品牌分工：一汽主攻四环，上汽聚焦 AUDI 字母标
item.guid: 奥迪中国明确品牌分工：一汽主攻四环，上汽聚焦-AUDI-字母标
item.description:
Audi's two brand systems in China now have a clearer division of labor. On October 26, according to a report by First Financial reporter Wu Ziye, Audi signed strategic agreements with FAW Group and SAIC Group respectively, clarifying the differentiated positioning of the Four Rings brand and the AUDI letter logo brand, as well as a "dual brand, dual partner" channel structure. 奥迪在中国的两套品牌体系有了更清晰的分工。10 月 26 日，据第一财经记者武子晔报道，奥迪分别与中国一汽、上汽集团签署战略协议，明确四环品牌与 AUDI 字母标品牌的差异化定位，以及「双品牌、双合作伙伴」渠道架构。

FAW Group will strengthen the Audi Four Rings brand's presence in both intelligent luxury new energy vehicles and fuel vehicles; SAIC Audi will focus on the AUDI letter-mark brand, specialize in the new energy market, and develop next-generation intelligent connected vehicles for Chinese consumers. 中国一汽将强化奥迪四环品牌在智能豪华新能源车型和燃油车型两个领域的布局；上汽奥迪则聚焦 AUDI 字母标品牌，专注新能源市场，开发面向中国消费者的下一代智能网联汽车。

During the transition period, SAIC Audi can continue to sell Four Rings products normally until the end of 2027. After-sales services for SAIC Audi's existing Four Rings products and AUDI letter-mark products will maintain stable operations. 过渡期内，上汽奥迪仍可在 2027 年底前正常销售四环产品。上汽奥迪旗下既有四环产品，以及 AUDI 字母标产品的售后服务均将保持平稳运营。

item.title: 大众中国获得 L3 路测牌照，已在合肥启动实路测试
item.guid: 大众中国获得-L3-路测牌照，已在合肥启动实路测试
item.description:
Volkswagen Group China announced that it has obtained an L3 autonomous driving road test license in Hefei and has initiated real road testing and data collection. 大众汽车集团（中国）宣布，已在合肥获得 L3 级自动驾驶道路测试牌照，并启动真实道路测试与数据采集。

According to an announcement released by Volkswagen China on October 26, this license acquisition is a step towards achieving L3 autonomous driving technology readiness by 2027. The scope announced this time is for road testing, and the 2027 milestone given by the group is also a technology readiness target. 大众中国 10 月 26 日发布的公告称，这次获牌是向 2027 年实现 L3 级自动驾驶技术就绪迈进的一步。本次公布的范围为道路测试，集团给出的 2027 年节点也是技术就绪目标。

On October 28, the first Volkswagen Group China Technology Day will be held in Hefei, showcasing the latest technological advancements. 10 月 28 日，首届大众汽车集团（中国）技术日将在合肥举行，集中展示最新技术进展。

item.title: Anthropic 确认部分内部系统遭研究人员访问，客户对话与模型权重未受影响
item.guid: Anthropic-确认部分内部系统遭研究人员访问，客户对话与模型权重未受影响
item.description:
According to an October 26 report by The Washington Post, cybersecurity startup Cathedral gained access to Anthropic's internal systems by exploiting a third-party enterprise software vulnerability under Anthropic's external security testing program. Cathedral's draft report stated that an AI agent, running for less than 12 hours, found paths to access meeting transcripts, compensation and hiring information, and Slack messages discussing some models. 据《华盛顿邮报》10 月 26 日报道，网络安全初创公司 Cathedral 在 Anthropic 的外部安全测试计划下，利用第三方企业软件漏洞进入其内部系统。Cathedral 的报告草稿称，AI 智能体运行不到 12 小时，就找到了访问会议实录、薪酬与录用信息，以及部分讨论模型的 Slack 消息的路径。

Anthropic confirmed that researchers accessed limited parts of its sales, human resources, and IT systems, involving business contact information for some customers and partners, as well as basic account records; messages sent by customers to models, model responses, AI system code, and model weights were not accessed. Anthropic 确认，研究人员访问了销售、人力资源和 IT 系统中的有限部分，涉及部分客户与合作伙伴的商业联系信息，以及基本账户记录；客户发给模型的消息、模型回复、AI 系统代码和模型权重均未被访问。

The company stated that monitoring systems had detected some activity before Cathedral's report and cut off access that same day; currently, there is no evidence that others exploited these vulnerabilities. The affected enterprise software was deactivated and only reactivated after the vendor confirmed a fix. 公司称，监控系统在 Cathedral 报告前已发现部分活动，并于当天切断访问；目前没有证据显示其他人利用了这些漏洞。涉事企业软件被停用，供应商确认修复后才重新启用。

Both parties still have disagreements regarding the testing process. Anthropic believes Cathedral exaggerated the national security impact and did not fully disclose its activities within the system; Cathedral, on the other hand, stated that it followed security research practices and limited data access to the necessary minimum. 双方对测试过程仍有分歧。Anthropic 认为 Cathedral 夸大了国家安全影响，且未完整披露在系统内的活动；Cathedral 则称已遵循安全研究惯例，把数据访问限制在必要的最低程度。

item.title: Cadence 推出 Maestro 芯片设计模型，可在客户防火墙内运行
item.guid: Cadence-推出-Maestro-芯片设计模型，可在客户防火墙内运行
item.description:
Chip design software company Cadence released its Maestro AI model portfolio, designed to power its chip and system design agents. The models can be deployed on Cadence Cloud, public clouds, or run within customers' own data centers and firewalls. 芯片设计软件公司 Cadence 发布 Maestro AI 模型组合，用于驱动旗下芯片与系统设计智能体。模型可部署在 Cadence 云、公共云，也可放在客户自己的数据中心和防火墙内运行。

Maestro partially uses NVIDIA's open-weight Nemotron models and incorporates OpenShell security technology; customers can fine-tune it with their own chip design data. Cadence connects the models, reinforcement learning processes, and EDA design tools to continuously optimize design decisions based on engineering results. Maestro 部分采用英伟达开放权重 Nemotron 模型，并结合 OpenShell 安全技术；客户可以用自己的芯片设计数据微调。Cadence 将模型、强化学习流程与 EDA 设计工具连接起来，依据工程结果持续优化设计决策。

The company stated that initial design process tests achieved up to a 30% quality improvement and up to 5 times Token usage efficiency compared to general foundational models; these are its early test results. The first batch of models is planned to be opened to some early customers in the fourth quarter. Paul Cunningham, Cadence's Senior Vice President, told Reuters that Maestro considers both open and closed-weight model approaches. 公司称，初期设计流程测试较通用基础模型实现最高 30% 的质量提升、最高 5 倍 Token 使用效率；这些是其早期测试结果。首批模型计划于第四季度向部分早期客户开放。Cadence 高级副总裁 Paul Cunningham 向路透社表示，Maestro 同时考虑开放和封闭权重模型路线。

item.title: 微软向约 6 万名员工提供自愿离职方案，最迟 12 月初决定
item.guid: 微软向约-6-万名员工提供自愿离职方案，最迟-12-月初决定
item.description:
According to Business Insider, which reviewed employee plans and obtained confirmation from Microsoft, Microsoft is offering voluntary separation compensation to approximately 60,000 employees across some teams in the US, Canada, UK, and India. The number of eligible individuals does not represent the final number of departures; employees can decide whether to accept by early December and leave by the end of the year. 据 Business Insider 查看员工方案并获得微软确认，微软向约 6 万名员工提供自愿离职补偿，覆盖美国、加拿大、英国和印度部分团队。符合条件的人数不代表最终离职人数；员工可在 12 月初前决定是否接受，并于年底离开。

Compensation is calculated separately based on job level, region, and length of service. In the US plan reviewed by the media, employees at level 64 and below receive one week of base salary for every six months of service, while those at levels 65 to 67 receive two weeks of base salary for every six months of service; the standard compensation cap for level 67 and below is 39 weeks of base salary. 补偿按职级、地区和任职年限分别计算。该媒体查看的美国方案中，64 级及以下员工每任职半年可获一周基本工资，65 至 67 级每半年可获两周基本工资；67 级及以下标准补偿上限为 39 周基本工资。

The plan also includes continued vesting of stock and health insurance, with standard stock vesting periods for employees at level 67 and below divided into 6 or 12 months based on length of service. A Microsoft spokesperson stated that there are currently no plans to reintroduce similar voluntary separation programs. 方案还包括继续归属的股票和医疗保险，其中 67 级及以下员工的标准股票归属期按工龄分为 6 个月或 12 个月。微软发言人表示，目前没有再次推出同类自愿离职方案的计划。

item.title: Meta 启动约 350 亿美元股权融资，另拟推出 600 亿美元售股计划
item.guid: Meta-启动约-350-亿美元股权融资，另拟推出-600-亿美元售股计划
item.description:
Meta announced on October 26 the launch of two public offerings totaling approximately $35 billion, including about $22.5 billion in Class A common stock and approximately $12.5 billion in depositary shares representing mandatory convertible preferred stock. The company stated that these arrangements will support investments in AI infrastructure and "personal super intelligence". Meta 10 月 26 日宣布启动两项公开发行，合计约 350 亿美元，包括约 225 亿美元 A 类普通股，以及代表强制可转换优先股的约 125 亿美元存托股份。公司称，这些安排将支持 AI 基础设施及「个人超级智能」投入。

Another at-the-market stock offering plan of approximately $60 billion is intended to launch after the newly established Class C common stock begins trading, expected no earlier than Q1 2027. The combined base size of the two parts is approximately $95 billion; future plans have not yet been signed, and the actual launch time, scale, and terms remain undetermined. 另一项约 600 亿美元的按市价售股计划，拟在新设 C 类普通股开始交易后启动，预计不早于 2027 年第一季度。两部分基础规模合计约 950 亿美元；未来计划尚未签署协议，实际启动时间、规模和条款仍未确定。

NVIDIA, AMD, and Broadcom each expressed an intention to purchase up to $5 billion of this common stock, but these intentions are non-binding, and the actual purchase amounts may be adjusted. 英伟达、AMD 和博通各表达了购买至多 50 亿美元本次普通股的意向，但均不具约束力，实际购买额可能调整。

This financing will also be disbursed in phases. The Class A common stock offering uses forward sale agreements, meaning Meta will not directly receive the proceeds from these sales initially but will obtain funds upon future settlement. The company stated that it will jointly support computing power construction with operating cash flow, investment-grade debt, strategic partnerships, and equity capital. 这笔融资也分阶段到账。A 类普通股发行采用远期销售协议，Meta 初期不会直接取得该部分售股款，而将在未来结算时获得资金。公司表示，将以经营现金流、投资级债务、战略合作和股权资本共同支持算力建设。

item.title: SpaceX 获约 400 亿美元 GPU 融资承诺，将租赁英伟达 Vera Rubin 设备
item.guid: SpaceX-获约-400-亿美元-GPU-融资承诺，将租赁英伟达-Vera-Rubin-设备
item.description:
SpaceX announced on October 26 a binding commitment with entities managed by Apollo Global Management for a master financing lease of approximately $40 billion for GPUs and related equipment, intended for expanding ground-based computing infrastructure. The equipment will include NVIDIA's next-generation Vera Rubin chips. SpaceX 10 月 26 日公布，与阿波罗全球管理公司管理的实体达成约 400 亿美元 GPU 及相关设备主融资租赁的约束性承诺，用于扩建地面算力基础设施。设备将包括英伟达下一代 Vera Rubin 芯片。

This financing was led by Apollo and Goldman Sachs, with Goldman Sachs serving as the exclusive structural design agent; BlackRock, funds and accounts under Goldman Sachs Asset Management, and capital accounts advised by KKR also made core investment commitments. 这笔融资由阿波罗与高盛牵头，高盛担任独家结构设计代理；贝莱德、高盛资产管理旗下基金及账户，以及 KKR 提供顾问服务的资本账户也作出核心投资承诺。

The transaction still needs to meet agreed-upon closing conditions and is expected to be completed by the end of 2026, with specific leasing arrangements anticipated to commence after the delivery of GPUs and related equipment in the first half of 2027. 交易仍须满足约定交割条件，预计在 2026 年底前完成，具体租赁安排预计随 GPU 和相关设备于 2027 年上半年交付后启动。

SpaceX stated that the new computing power will support Grok for enterprises and consumers, as well as existing and future cloud service customers; lease financing is also part of its plan to diversify funding sources and accelerate computing power deployment. SpaceX 表示，新增算力将支持面向企业与消费者的 Grok，以及现有和未来的云服务客户；租赁融资也是其分散资金来源、加快算力部署计划的一部分。

item.title: 💡 比尔·盖茨：AI 带来富足前，要先度过约 20 年的动荡
item.guid: 💡-比尔·盖茨：AI-带来富足前，要先度过约-20-年的动荡
item.description:
Bill Gates stated in a Decoder podcast interview aired on October 22 that AI can reduce shortages in areas such as housing, food, and healthcare, but he is more concerned about the approximately 20-year transition period to abundance: during which there will be winners, losers, and significant disruptions. 比尔·盖茨在 10 月 22 日播出的 Decoder 播客访谈中表示，AI 能够减少住房、食物和医疗等领域的短缺，但他更担心通往富足的约 20 年过渡期：其间会出现赢家、输家和大量冲击。

In Gates' view, white-collar jobs such as telemarketing, customer service, and accounting will be affected first, and humanoid robots may later change manual labor. Work simultaneously provides income, a sense of purpose, collegial relationships, and opportunities to solve problems; simply making goods cheaper cannot answer how people obtain these things. 在盖茨看来，电话销售、客服和会计等白领岗位会先受到影响，人形机器人随后也可能改变体力劳动。工作同时提供收入、目标感、同事关系与解决问题的机会，单靠商品变便宜无法回答人们如何获得这些东西。

He cited his philanthropic work as an example: even if organizing resources to eliminate malaria was once his unique contribution, AI might do it better, sending him off to play pickleball. For young people hoping to make unique contributions, this shift in capabilities will create pressure. 他以自己的慈善工作举例：即使组织资源消除疟疾曾是他的独特贡献，AI 也可能做得更好，把他打发去打匹克球。对希望作出独特贡献的年轻人来说，这种能力变化会带来压力。

Gates suggested that humans could choose to reserve fields like childcare, cooking, art, and sports for people, even if AI could do them better; early retirement and shorter workweeks are also debatable solutions. These arrangements require society to make policy choices. He believes that some people might actively distance themselves from the technological frontier to preserve space for mutual help and unique contributions. 盖茨提出，人类可以选择把育儿、烹饪、艺术和体育等领域保留给人来做，即使 AI 能做得更好；提前退休、缩短工作周也是可讨论的办法。这些安排需要社会作出政策选择。他认为，一部分人可能主动远离技术前沿，以保留互相帮助和作出独特贡献的空间。

He also emphasized that 20 years is just a relatively conservative estimate he chose, and the actual time could be longer or shorter. If AI development is not significantly slowed down or stopped, robots will gradually take on tasks such as building houses, growing food, and performing surgeries; humans need to decide how to arrange life in an era of abundance, and his current focus remains on navigating this transition period. 他同时强调，20 年只是自己选取的一个相对稳妥的估计，实际时间可能更长或更短。如果不大幅放缓或停止 AI 发展，机器人将逐步承担建房、种植食物和手术等工作；人类需要决定如何安排富足时代的生活，而他当前的重点仍是如何度过这段转型期。

item.title: 卢伟冰称 REDMI K100「同档无敌」，新配色雪岩白公布
item.guid: 卢伟冰称-REDMI-K100「同档无敌」，新配色雪岩白公布
item.description:
The REDMI K100 will be released on October 27 at 19:00. Lu Weibing, President of Xiaomi Group, posted a preview on October 26, calling it "another unbeatable product in its class." REDMI K100 将于 10 月 27 日 19:00 发布。小米集团总裁卢伟冰 10 月 26 日发文预告，并称其「又是一款同档无敌的产品」。

REDMI officially unveiled a new color scheme, "Snow Rock White," on the same day. The phone's back features a delicate texture reminiscent of Xuan paper and is now available for pre-order on major e-commerce platforms. REDMI 官方同日公布新配色「雪岩白」，机身背部采用宣纸般的细腻纹理，并已在各大电商平台开启预约。

item.title: 魏牌高山 8 HEV 上市，不插电油混版限时置换权益价 25.98 万元起
item.guid: 魏牌高山-8-HEV-上市，不插电油混版限时置换权益价-25.98-万元起
item.description:
The Wey Gaoshan 8 HEV was launched on October 26, introducing two models: the Shuxiang Edition and the Zhenxiang Edition, with official prices of 265,800 yuan and 285,800 yuan, respectively. Autohome's listing information obtained from Wey's official sources shows limited-time trade-in prices of 259,800 yuan and 279,800 yuan. 魏牌高山 8 HEV 于 10 月 26 日上市，推出舒享版和臻享版两款车型，官方售价分别为 26.58 万元、28.58 万元；汽车之家向魏牌官方取得的上市信息将限时置换权益价列为 25.98 万元、27.98 万元。

The new car features a hybrid system consisting of a 2.0T engine and front and rear dual motors, with Hi4 four-wheel drive as standard across all models. It is equipped with a 3.64kWh battery and does not require external charging. The system's combined maximum power is 322kW, peak torque is 782N·m, 0-100 km/h acceleration is 5.9 seconds, and WLTC combined fuel consumption is 6.92L/100km. 新车采用 2.0T 发动机与前后双电机组成的油电混动系统，全系标配 Hi4 四驱，配备 3.64kWh 电池，无需外接充电。系统综合最大功率为 322kW，峰值扭矩 782N·m，零百加速 5.9 秒，WLTC 综合油耗为 6.92L/100km。

The car body is 5280mm long with a 3145mm wheelbase, featuring a three-row, seven-seat layout, continuing the flat floor and shared rail design for the second and third rows. The cockpit uses Coffee OS 3.5 and the Qualcomm 8295P chip, supporting HiCar, Carlink, and CarPlay. The assisted driving system is Coffee Pilot 3, equipped with a 192-line lidar, 27 sensors, and an Orin-Y chip. 车身长 5280mm、轴距 3145mm，采用三排七座布局，延续纯平地板和二、三排共轨设计。座舱使用 Coffee OS 3.5 与高通 8295P 芯片，支持 HiCar、Carlink 和 CarPlay。辅助驾驶系统为 Coffee Pilot 3，配置 192 线激光雷达、27 个传感器和 Orin-Y 芯片。

item.title: 无问芯穹与三体宇宙发布智子 Agent，可延续跨会话记忆
item.guid: 无问芯穹与三体宇宙发布智子-Agent，可延续跨会话记忆
item.description:
Wuwenshinqiong and Three-Body Universe announced a strategic partnership and launched their first collaborative product, "Sophon Agent 1.0," at the "2026 Three-Body Day · Dehydration Immersion Carnival" held in Beijing on October 25. This AI conversational agent uses Sophon, the mini-universe administrator from "The Three-Body Problem," as its character anchor, supporting multi-turn conversations and cross-session memory. 无问芯穹与三体宇宙于 10 月 25 日在北京举行的「2026 三体日·脱水浸泡嘉年华」上宣布战略合作，并发布首个合作产品「智子 Agent 1.0」。这款 AI 对话智能体以《三体》中的小宇宙管理员智子为角色锚点，支持多轮交流和跨会话记忆。

In their division of labor, Three-Body Universe is responsible for world-building, character boundaries, and personality traits; Wuwenshinqiong provides infrastructure such as agent development, knowledge and memory management, and inference services. The product is built on the AgentWorks platform, organizing world-building data into a searchable knowledge base, managing character tone through layered prompt words, and using Infini Memory to maintain memory across different sessions. 双方分工中，三体宇宙负责世界观设定、角色边界和人格特征；无问芯穹提供智能体开发、知识与记忆管理、推理服务等基础设施。产品基于 AgentWorks 平台构建，将世界观资料整理为可检索的知识库，通过分层提示词管理角色语气，并用 Infini Memory 延续不同会话之间的记忆。

According to Wuwenshinqiong, during dialogue generation, character expression and world-building knowledge retrieval occur in parallel; the initial draft also undergoes an independent review module to check for character deviation and setting breaches, and then specific conflicts are sent back for modification. The system is responsible for identifying clear factual discrepancies, while the Three-Body Universe content team ensures that character expressions align with the original work. 据无问芯穹介绍，对话生成时，角色表达与世界观知识检索并行进行；初稿还要经过独立审校模块，排查人设偏离和设定越界，再把具体冲突送回修改。系统负责定位明确的事实偏差，角色表达是否贴合原作则由三体宇宙内容团队把关。

The two parties will also explore long-term character memory and relationship evolution, multi-character shared world-building narratives, and multimodal interaction in the future. 双方后续还将探索角色长期记忆与关系演进、多角色共享世界观叙事，以及多模态交互。

item.title: 腾讯混元开源 Hy-Nomas，可用文字和镜头逐段生成视频世界
item.guid: 腾讯混元开源-Hy-Nomas，可用文字和镜头逐段生成视频世界
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan Vision Generation Team open-sourced the interactive video world model Hy-Nomas and provides an online demo. Users first describe a scene, then use multi-turn text or camera trajectories to control subsequent segments, gradually changing objects, styles, scenes, and character actions. 腾讯混元视觉生成团队开源交互式视频世界模型 Hy-Nomas，并提供在线演示。用户先描述场景，再用多轮文字或相机轨迹控制后续片段，逐步改变物体、风格、场景与角色动作。

The model generates segments autoregressively and retains KV cache throughout the generation process to help subsequent frames continue the previous scene. The interactive interface supports continuous input of instructions between segments and allows camera adjustments with the keyboard; a real-world test by the official account "Product Notes" demonstrated the process of first generating a cat in the kitchen, then specifying the cat to stand up, stretch, and walk forward. 模型按片段自回归生成，并保留贯穿生成过程的 KV 缓存，帮助后续画面延续前面的场景。交互界面支持在片段之间继续输入指令，也可以用键盘调整镜头；公众号「产品笔记」的实测展示了先生成厨房里的猫，再继续指定猫起身、伸懒腰和向前行走的过程。

The official repository has released training, inference, demo, and data annotation code, with model weights simultaneously launched on Hugging Face. Developers can perform LoRA fine-tuning with their own videos; low VRAM configurations support a single RTX 4090, reducing VRAM requirements through INT8 weights and caching, sliding window history, and CPU offloading, though offloading will increase data transfer overhead. The project uses the Apache 2.0 license. 官方仓库已公开训练、推理、演示和数据标注代码，模型权重同步上线 Hugging Face。开发者可用自有视频做 LoRA 微调；低显存配置支持单张 RTX 4090，通过 INT8 权重与缓存、滑动窗口历史及 CPU 卸载降低显存需求，卸载也会增加数据传输开销。项目采用 Apache 2.0 许可。

item.title: 即梦上线短剧工作室，剧本、分镜与局部重拍可在同一平台完成
item.guid: 即梦上线短剧工作室，剧本、分镜与局部重拍可在同一平台完成
item.description:
Jimen AI announced on October 26 the launch of "Short Drama Studio," integrating scriptwriting, art design, storyboarding, post-production, and finished film remaking into a single creative workflow. The web version already provides entry points for script upload, script creation, and remake/redrawing. 即梦 AI 10 月 26 日宣布上线「短剧工作室」，将剧本、美术设定、分镜、后期和成片重制放进同一套创作流程。网页端已提供上传剧本、剧本创作和重制转绘入口。

According to the official introduction, the self-developed script model DreamScript supports original, adapted, overseas, and commentary themes, and can parse long texts of up to 100,000 characters; the image model Anycook is designed for short drama character and scene design, while the storyboard model DreamShot supports canvas, storyboard, and 3D director's desk pre-visualization. 官方介绍，自研剧本模型 DreamScript 支持原创、改编、出海、解说等题材，并可解析 10 万字长篇文本；图片模型 Anycook 面向短剧角色与场景设计，分镜模型 DreamShot 则支持画布、故事板及 3D 导演台预演。

Post-production tools can regenerate unsatisfactory individual clips, separate vocals from background audio, or split shots. Remake and redrawing can identify characters, scenes, and shot structures from existing short dramas, then generate different versions according to target style, aspect ratio, and market. The official page also offers intelligent pre-visualization, video analysis, and up to 4K upscaling features. 后期工具可对不满意的单个片段重新生成，分离人声与背景音，或拆分镜头。重制转绘可识别已有短剧的角色、场景和镜头结构，再按目标风格、画幅与市场生成不同版本。官方页面还提供智能预演、视频拉片和最高 4K 超分功能。

item.title: 腾讯开源中英同声传译模型 Hy-SimulMT，支持边听边译与音色克隆
item.guid: 腾讯开源中英同声传译模型-Hy-SimulMT，支持边听边译与音色克隆
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan announced on October 26 the release and open-sourcing of the Hy-SimulMT simultaneous interpretation model, supporting bidirectional speech translation between Chinese and English. The model continuously receives the speaker's audio, outputs translation and speech while listening, and preserves the speaker's voice characteristics through real-time voice cloning. The Tencent Hy Translate App already provides an entry point for experience. 腾讯混元 10 月 26 日发布并开源 Hy-SimulMT 同声传译模型，支持中文与英文之间的双向语音翻译。模型可持续接收说话人的音频，边听边输出译文和语音，并通过实时音色克隆保留说话人的声音特征。腾讯 Hy 翻译 App 已提供体验入口。

The open-source project includes the SimulInfer inference service and SimulTrain training tools. The model provides two versions: translation output and interleaved output of original and translated text, and is available in formats such as FP8 and GGUF. When developers deploy it, speech output and voice cloning also require TTS service configuration. 开源项目包含 SimulInfer 推理服务和 SimulTrain 训练工具，模型提供翻译输出与原文、译文交错输出两种版本，并有 FP8、GGUF 等格式。开发者部署时，语音输出与音色克隆还需要配置 TTS 服务。

In Tencent's RealSI long audio evaluation, the model's StreamLAAL metric was approximately 3 seconds, indicating the streaming delay of the translation relative to the input audio, not the time taken for the first speech output. According to the GEMBA translation quality score of this evaluation, its results were higher than the open-source models and 4 out of 5 commercial APIs included in the comparison. 腾讯公布的 RealSI 长音频评测中，模型的 StreamLAAL 指标约为 3 秒，表示译文相对输入音频的流式延迟，并非首次语音输出耗时。按该评测的 GEMBA 翻译质量评分，其结果高于参与对比的开源模型及 5 个商业 API 中的 4 个。

The team also conducted a small-scale comparison using 18 segments of approximately 6-minute Chinese and English audio with 6 professional simultaneous interpreters; the results are only applicable to the samples used, participants, and test settings, and cannot be used to infer that all scenarios can replace human simultaneous interpretation. 团队还用 18 段约 6 分钟的中英文音频，与 6 位专业同传译员作了小规模比较；结果只适用于所用样本、参与者和测试设置，不能据此推断所有场景都可替代人工同传。

item.title: 老干妈否认「600 人裁至 48 人」，确认已应用 AI 质检
item.guid: 老干妈否认「600-人裁至-48-人」，确认已应用-AI-质检
item.description:
Lao Gan Ma responded to rumors that "after AI quality inspection went online, the number of chili pickers decreased from over 600 to 48." According to a report by Phoenix.com's "Eye of the Storm" on October 26, its reporter called Lao Gan Ma's human resources department, and staff explicitly stated that the rumored personnel adjustment content was false information. 老干妈回应了「AI 质检上线后，拣椒工人从 600 余人减至 48 人」的传闻。据凤凰网《风暴眼》10 月 26 日报道，其记者致电老干妈人力资源部门，工作人员明确表示，网传人员调整内容为假消息。

The staff member confirmed that AI quality inspection technology has been launched and applied in the production base, but the company has never had personnel adjustment arrangements of the corresponding scale, stating that "we have never used so many workers." 该工作人员确认，AI 质检技术已在生产基地上线应用，但企业从未有过对应规模的人员调整安排，并称「从来都没有用过这么多工人」。

item.title: ROG ×《影之刃零》首批联名硬件开售，武侠设计覆盖主机与外设
item.guid: ROG-×《影之刃零》首批联名硬件开售，武侠设计覆盖主机与外设
item.description:
The first batch of co-branded hardware for "Phantom Blade Zero," launched in collaboration between ROG and S-GAME, went on sale at 10:00 on October 26, covering mini PCs, monitors, keyboards, headphones, mice, and keycap sets. ROG 与灵游坊 S-GAME 合作推出的《影之刃零》首批联名硬件于 10 月 26 日 10:00 开售，覆盖迷你主机、显示器、键盘、耳机、鼠标和键帽包。

The official product page integrates black and red color schemes, blade textures, weapon carvings, character silhouettes, and crimson bloodlines into the hardware's appearance. The NUC 16 co-branded mini PC features a translucent front panel printed with the silhouette of the protagonist "Soul," and its stand is detachable, supporting both horizontal and vertical placement. 官方产品页将黑红配色、刀刃纹理、武器雕刻、角色剪影与绯红血线融入硬件外观。NUC 16 联名迷你主机的半透明前面板印有主角「魂」的剪影，支架可以拆卸，支持横放和竖放。

The NUC 16 co-branded edition can be configured with a Core Ultra 9 290HX processor and an RTX 5080 laptop GPU, featuring a triple-fan design and an integrated vapor chamber, supporting tool-free memory and SSD upgrades. Gamersky reported that the co-branded chassis will be sold separately on October 29; purchasing designated products and completing official website registration allows participation in a limited game redemption code giveaway event. NUC 16 联名版可选配酷睿 Ultra 9 290HX 处理器及 RTX 5080 笔记本电脑 GPU，采用三风扇和一体式均热板，支持免工具升级内存与固态硬盘。游民星空报道，联名机箱将于 10 月 29 日单独开售；购买指定产品并完成官网登记，可参与数量有限的游戏兑换码赠送活动。

item.title: 大众点评内测「生活家」：找店、打卡和互动也能攒成长分
item.guid: 大众点评内测「生活家」：找店、打卡和互动也能攒成长分
item.description:
Dianping is internally testing the "Lifestyle Expert" user growth system in some cities. Jiemian News learned from multiple users on October 26, and reporters confirmed through testing, that some users in Hefei, Zhengzhou, Fuzhou, and other places can already see the entry point on the "My" page of the App. 大众点评正在部分城市内测「生活家」用户成长体系。界面新闻 10 月 26 日从多位用户处获悉，并经记者测试确认，合肥、郑州、福州等地部分用户已能在 App「我的」页面看到入口。

Compared to the original Lv system, which primarily relied on points from publishing reviews, "Lifestyle Expert" covers more daily behaviors. Reviews, notes, check-ins, public reviews, location tagging, and contributing information all earn growth points; interactions like finding stores, liking, and replying to other users' reviews are also included. The plan emphasizes tracking footprints and helping other users discover good places. 与原有主要依靠发布评价积分的 Lv 体系相比，「生活家」覆盖更多日常行为。评价、笔记、打卡、大众评审、地点标记与贡献信息均可获得成长分，找店、点赞、回复他人评价等互动也被纳入；计划强调足迹记录，以及帮助其他用户发现好去处。

The new system has 1 to 18 levels. In addition to free trials and in-store gifts, benefits also include taxi vouchers, coupon packs, etc. Old users who consistently maintain review and record habits usually have higher levels in the new system. This is a grayscale test for some cities, not yet a full user switch. 新体系共设 1 至 18 级，权益除免费试、到店礼外，还包括打车券、券包等。长期保持评价和记录习惯的老用户，在新体系中的等级通常也较高。此次为部分城市灰测，尚非全量用户切换。

item.title: 《三星堆：未来往事》上映第四天票房约 119 万元，博纳影业股价跌停
item.guid: 《三星堆：未来往事》上映第四天票房约-119-万元，博纳影业股价跌停
item.description:
After the feature film "Sanxingdui: Future Memories," deeply involved in AI production, was released on October 23, its market performance was lukewarm during the first weekend. According to data from Maoyan Pro cited by "National Business Daily," as of noon on October 26, the cumulative box office for this 100-minute film was 1.192 million yuan, with an average of about 2 viewers per screening on October 24 and 25. AI 深度参与制作的院线长片《三星堆：未来往事》10 月 23 日上映后，首个周末的市场表现偏冷。据《每日经济新闻》援引猫眼专业版数据，截至 10 月 26 日午间，这部 100 分钟影片的累计综合票房为 119.2 万元，24 日、25 日场均观影人数均约 2 人。

The page at noon on the 26th showed that there were 8,469 screenings that day, with an occupancy rate of approximately 0.1%. On the same day, Bona Film Group's stock price hit its daily limit down, closing with a 10.06% decrease. Previously, the company's stock had hit its daily limit up on three trading days: September 28, October 9, and October 12. 26 日午间页面显示，当日排片 8469 场，上座率约 0.1%。同一天，制作方博纳影业股价跌停，收盘跌幅为 10.06%。此前，公司曾于 9 月 28 日、10 月 9 日和 12 日三个交易日涨停。

Bona Film Group had already warned in its stock trading abnormal fluctuation announcement on October 12 that the film's box office revenue had uncertainties. The company's other AI theatrical film, "Unplanned: Guanghan Action," has entered the production phase and, as of the announcement disclosure date, has not yet obtained a public release license nor has it been officially scheduled. 博纳影业已在 10 月 12 日的股票交易异常波动公告中提示，该片票房收益存在不确定性。公司另一部 AI 院线电影《计划外：广寒行动》已进入制作阶段，截至该公告披露日尚未取得公映许可证，也未正式定档。

item.title: 2026《鸿蒙星光盛典》定档 12 月 5 日
item.guid: 2026《鸿蒙星光盛典》定档-12-月-5-日
item.description:
The 2026 "HarmonyOS Starlight Gala" will be held on December 5 at the "Spring Cocoon" Stadium in Shenzhen Bay Sports Center. CCTV News released an official announcement poster on October 26, announcing that this event, combining technology and art, will be held again. 2026《鸿蒙星光盛典》将于 12 月 5 日在深圳湾体育中心「春茧」体育场举办。央视新闻于 10 月 26 日发布官宣海报，宣布这场科技与文艺结合的活动再度举行。

CCTV Video simultaneously released a preview video for the gala, connecting last year's "Together, We Can" with this year's "Together, Towards the Future." The official position for this year's event is a reunion of technology and art, hoping to showcase the joint participation of creators and users in the HarmonyOS ecosystem and the development of application experiences through the gala. 央视频同步发布了盛典预告视频，将去年的「在一起，就可以」与今年的「在一起，向未来」相衔接。官方把本届活动定位为科技与文艺的再次相逢，希望以盛典呈现鸿蒙生态中创造者与用户的共同参与，以及应用体验的发展。

item.title: 路阳监制电影《试探》定档 11 月 21 日，发布新预告
item.guid: 路阳监制电影《试探》定档-11-月-21-日，发布新预告
item.description:
The film "Temptation" announced its nationwide release on November 21, and released the "Open the Door to Ghosts" trailer on October 26. The film is executive produced by Lu Yang and Wang Hongwei, directed by Hou Xiaoyao, and stars Feng Shaofeng, Chen Yusi, and Li Meng. Guo Yue, Che Xiao, Zhou Yemang, and Yang Yi will also appear. 电影《试探》宣布将于 11 月 21 日全国上映，并于 10 月 26 日释出「开门见诡」版预告。影片由路阳、王红卫监制，侯逍遥执导，冯绍峰、陈雨锶、李梦领衔主演。郭月、车晓、周野芒、杨轶也将出演。

The trailer sets the story in a villa: Ding Boyang, Maya, and Wanying engage in a secret confrontation, with suspicion and danger constantly escalating, and someone secretly observing them from the shadows. 预告将故事放进一栋别墅：丁伯阳、马娅与万影三人暗中交锋，猜忌与危险不断升级，还有人在暗处窥探他们。
